text:
Nora (Product): Quick heads-up: launching Escrowed Key Flow for Private/VPC agents at 18:00 UTC today. Purpose: allow customers to escrow agent signing keys with a customer-managed KMS so audit bundles can be verified independently. Will require a one-time key upload or KMS config.

Diego (Eng): Tech note: agent accepts kms_config.json with fields: key_provider, key_id, public_key_pem. Example registration: ```POST /agent/keys/register -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -d '{"key_provider":"aws-kms","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:..."}'``` Agent will rotate agent-signing keys locally and publish the escrowed public key in the audit bundle as signer_kid.

Rita (SRE): Rollout plan: 10-customer canary 18:00-18:20 UTC, watch "bundle-verify-failure" and "key-register-error". If verify failures >0.2% over 5m rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for private-escrow-keyflow-v1 at 2026-08-04T18:00Z.

Nora (Product): Action items: Legal - confirm audit wording and liability for escrowed keys; Support - KB and verification steps; Sales - 1-sentence customer blurb + list of canary customers.

Omar (Legal): Need clear language that escrowed public keys are customer-supplied and that platform does not retain private key material. Also require signer_kid and key_provider in bundles. Legal ok pending KB link.

Paul (Sales): Draft blurb request: 20 words or less. Also need canary list for CSM outreach.

Diego (Eng): Draft blurb: "Escrow your agent signing key to your KMS so audit bundles include a customer-validated signer id for independent verification." Full docs to #docs after GA.

Rita (SRE): Canary update @18:12: 10 registrations, 0 register errors, bundle verification success 100%, median verify time 30ms. Proceeding to staged rollout at 18:25.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated for private-escrow-keyflow-v1 at 2026-08-04T18:25Z.

June (Support): I'll add KB "Register KMS keys for escrowed verification" with troubleshooting: check IAM perms, ensure public_key PEM format, verify signer_kid in bundle. Will post link when live.

Nora (Product): Thanks team. GA announcement tentatively tomorrow 16:00 UTC once Legal + Support confirm links. If anything odd, tag #eng-oncall and @Nora.
